limitations: Observes the existing initialization rollout; adds no simulator steps or control changes.
Scene centers use current free-joint positions or kinematics on separate scratch data; contacts use the preceding pre-integration solver state and its timestamp.
Only active solver contacts are measured; welded and other solver-filtered overlaps are not certified collision-free.
Robot-floor/self contacts are excluded. Scene-robot contacts are informational, not a robot initialization rejection rule.
Peak speed and transient penetration are evidence, not rejection thresholds; compliant landings can produce temporary contact penetration.

connectivity.method: optimistic rectangle arrangement with exact coordinate compression
limitations: Checks the configured 0.8m-diameter/1.6m-high planar clearance contract, not physical impossibility for every robot posture.
Only world-fixed boxes are blockers; movable/articulated ancestry, meshes, spheres and cylinders are omitted from obstruction proofs.
Rounded box-expansion corners are omitted and collision rectangles are relaxed by 1e-7m; possible routes are optimistic and never certified feasible.
Declared world bounds are not invisible walls; the exterior of all finite geometry is included.
Does not verify manipulation, stairs, climbing, door operation, temporal task execution, or general policy solvability.
connectivity.reason: Exact arrangement cell budget exceeded; no coarse-grid rejection attempted

limitations: Static geometry and a reset probe do not prove task reachability, completeness of natural-language interpretation, or policy solvability.
Material properties are estimated unless independently measured; temporal measurements have the recorded sampling resolution.
Surface finishes, floor pattern and studio lighting are visual estimates, not measured materials.

evidence_class: live model generation and sensor-only navigation; not manipulation or logistics
